caseNameFull: Warner Manufacturing Corp. v. Shane, trading as B. & F. Door Mfg. Co.
attorneys: Ceorge H. Rosenstein for petitioner. David S. Malis was on the stipulation for respondents. With him on a brief in opposition to the petition were Howard Wallner and Robert H. Malis.

opinions.text: On petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit. Dismissed per stipulation pursuant to Rule 60 of the Rules of this Court.
